Copy this template to `docs/specs/<change-id>/spec.md`. The italic line under each heading says whether the section is required, optional, or only needed in a given case, for L2 and for L3. Keep the sections your level requires and the conditional ones whose condition holds, add optional sections only when they help, and delete the rest; do not write `N/A`. Delete the italic marker lines too when you fill in the record. An L2 spec aims at about one page. Do not present pending fields as accepted requirements.
